DocumentKind.description:
The ``document_type`` breakdown files/08 §4 G asks of
``wait.records_processing_s``.

These are the THREE content types the ingest allow-list already accepts
(``intake_platform.documents.ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES``), renamed to a label
value. It is deliberately not a clinical document taxonomy — lab report,
discharge summary, prescription — because this repo has none and inventing

the build if the allow-list gains a type this enum does not cover.

MeasureCode.description:
What a patient can measure about themselves and be believed about.

detailed column, but INT-282 asserted by name that pulse (174_TC), blood
pressure (173_TC/354_TC) and respiration (49_TC) are *clinician-measured*

patient-typed blood pressure to sit in a clinician note beside
clinic-measured ones; this code set names only what the intake surface
actually collects. Adding a measured vital here is a clinical-safety
decision and not a schema one (docs/evidence/INT-084.md; HB-C14).

SelfReportedMeasure.description:
files/04 §5 ``PreVisitNote.measurements[]`` (added 2 Sep 2026, INT-084).

height and weight into a *mobile* section id rather than invent one
(docs/evidence/INT-282.md). This is that gap closed at the schema layer:
a self-report, typed as one, so no renderer can read it as a measurement
taken in clinic. The magnitude is an exact ``Decimal`` — invariant 22 does
not let a float cross a representation boundary — and the unit is the one
the patient's control was labelled with, never converted.

WaitKind.description:
The wait intervals files/08 §4 group G names and INT-241's acceptance
enumerates. A closed set: a kind outside group G has no catalogue row, so
it has no honest way to be emitted (invariant 13).
WaitKind.title: WaitKind

WaitV1.description:
One completed wait interval (INT-241; files/08 §4 group G).

**A duration, not two instants.** The interval is reduced to a scalar
before it is written: instants plus a session id are a queue position that
correlates to a person, a duration is not. The row's own ``created_at``
still owns event time (the module convention above), which is what puts
the observation inside a rollup window.

**No free text and no minimum unit of one.** ``kind`` and
``document_type`` are closed enumerations; ``duration_ms`` is a count of
milliseconds. There is nowhere for an identifier or a sentence to ride
(invariant 6), which is what lets the rollups read the payload directly.

document_type.description: Ingest content kind, for wait.records_processing_s only (files/08 §4 G: 'by document type'). None for every other kind.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed milliseconds between the interval's two instants, measured on a monotonic clock. A count, never a wall-clock pair.
duration_ms.title: Duration Ms

kind.description: Which files/08 §4 group G interval this measures (closed set).
